description: Fail-closed project governance hooks for task and review enforcement.

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'root=$PWD; while :; do runner=$root/.codex/hooks/run_python.sh; if [ -e "$root/.git" ] && [ -f "$runner" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$runner" session_start.py; fi; [ "$root" = / ] && break; parent=${root%/*}; [ -n "$parent" ] || parent=/; [ "$parent" = "$root" ] && break; root=$parent; done; echo "repository governance root not found" >&2; exit 69'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $runner = Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/run_python.ps1'; $gitMarker = Join-Path $root '.git'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $gitMarker) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)) { & $runner session_start.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $root; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $root) { Write-Error 'repository governance root not found'; exit 69 }; $root = $parent }"

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'root=$PWD; while :; do runner=$root/.codex/hooks/run_python.sh; if [ -e "$root/.git" ] && [ -f "$runner" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$runner" pre_tool_use.py; fi; [ "$root" = / ] && break; parent=${root%/*}; [ -n "$parent" ] || parent=/; [ "$parent" = "$root" ] && break; root=$parent; done; echo "repository governance root not found" >&2; exit 69'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = (Get-Location).Path; while ($true) { $runner = Join-Path $root '.codex/hooks/run_python.ps1'; $gitMarker = Join-Path $root '.git'; if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $gitMarker) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $runner -PathType Leaf)) { & $runner pre_tool_use.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent = Split-Path -Parent $root; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $root) { Write-Error 'repository governance root not found'; exit 69 }; $root = $parent }"
